title: Podesta emails and the DeLonge–McCasland–Weiss meeting
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Podesta emails and the DeLonge–McCasland–Weiss meeting, about 2015-2016 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Podesta email leak exposes the 'three kings'

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, describes emails of a Washington political figure, John Podesta, that were hacked and made public around 2015 and 2016. Simosa says they hold about 35 emails between a man named Tom DeLonge and Podesta's team, and point to a meeting between Podesta, DeLonge, an Air Force general named Neil McCasland, a man named Michael Carey, and Robert Weiss, head of the Skunk Works, a secret aircraft design shop. If true, it would show senior military and aerospace figures quietly meeting about UFO matters with people close to political power.
